integrity.claim_scope: Every positive electorate, integer seat count \(k\ge2\) and precisely \(k+3\) candidates, with an additional single-seat JR statement.
integrity.proof_basis: Pointwise rational dual certificate, nonnegative closed-form residual table, and explicit integer construction; finite verification is corroborative only.

scientific_limitations: The sharp bound concerns exactly three deletions and every permissible tie-breaking, not four or more deletions or the EJR axiom.
Attaining the extremal fraction may use ties; a separate 252-voter witness at six seats has uniquely forced deletions.
No exhaustive classification of all extremal elections or minimum electorate size is asserted.
Literature comparisons use accessible sources and indexed research; non-discovery is not proof of global publication priority.
title: A sharp unrepresented-voter bound for three-deletion reverse sequential PAV
